title: 《绝区零》3.1 角色展示异常与拥有感框架压力测试
brief: Use the verified Version 1.4 specific-angle fade adjustment and display-fix notice, the bounded media report of an ownership-related player frame, and the verified Version 3.1 release context to compile a synthetic stress test. Assume only for the counterfactual that a Version 3.1 character outfit fades outside its intended viewing boundary and visible discussion frames that behavior as restricted access to obtained content. Compare a delayed ambiguous response with a rapid boundary explanation, corrective update, explicitly scoped compensation, localized communication, and follow-up review. Do not claim this event will occur or output a real-world probability.

strategyLabels.baseline: 延迟且边界模糊的回应
strategyLabels.candidate: 快速说明边界 + 纠正更新 + 明确补偿范围 + 本地化复盘

successCriteria: Every historical and Version 3.1 context statement resolves to a public source and ledger Claim ID.
The synthetic fade event is never presented as a released Version 3.1 fact or forecast.
Only mappings approved in a content-addressed Theory System reach scenario compilation.
Every scenario, strategy, and stakeholder number binds to evidence or an explicit synthetic assumption.
The same compiled input and seed reproduce the same paired 42-day run.
boundaries: This is a synthetic counterfactual stress test, not a forecast or a real-world probability estimate.
The Version 1.4 notice confirms a display anomaly fix, not a full rollback of the fade adjustment.
The 300 Polychrome compensated a four-issue notice and cannot be attributed solely to the fade issue.
The Lucy outfit is a verified official product-context fact; no evidence says it will exhibit a fade issue or generate controversy.
Public posts and engagement cannot establish opinion prevalence or silent-player views.
Regional factors remain 1.0 unless direct regional evidence is added.
openEvidenceGaps: Obtain directly checked Japanese material before claiming three-language frame comparison.
Add timestamped public-community samples only if collection remains terms-compliant and reproducible.
Calibrate no effect size from this single historical event.
